items.source: Handle the given request and delegate messages to the provided WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: 将给定的请求委托到提供的 WebSocketHandler 处理消息。

items.source: Check whether the type of the given session matches the transport type of this TransportHandler where session id and the transport type are extracted from the SockJS URL.
items.translation: 检查给定会话的类型是否与此 `TransportHandler` 的传输类型匹配，其中会话 ID 和传输类型是从 SockJS URL 中提取的。

items.source: Handle a SockJS session URL, i.e. transport-specific request.
items.translation: 处理 SockJS 会话 URL，即特定传输的请求。

items.source: Return the transport type supported by this handler.
items.translation: 返回此处理器支持的传输类型。

items.source: Initialize this handler with the given configuration.
items.translation: 使用给定配置初始化此处理器。

items.source: true if the session matches (and would therefore get accepted by handleRequest(ServerHttpRequest, ServerHttpResponse, WebSocketHandler, SockJsSession)), or false otherwise
items.translation: 如果会话匹配（因此会被handleRequest(ServerHttpRequest, ServerHttpResponse, WebSocketHandler, SockJsSession)接受），则返回true，否则返回false

items.source: SockJsException - raised when request processing fails as explained in SockJsService
items.translation: SockJsException - 在请求处理失败时抛出，具体原因见 SockJsService

items.source: serviceConfig - the configuration as defined by the containing SockJsService
items.translation: serviceConfig - 由包含的 SockJsService 定义的配置
